title: Yoisaki Kanade — Clothes That Catch My Eye?〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Yoisaki Household - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: We're back...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Want me to make some tea?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, a little break would be nice...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Here's your cup, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you. Let me take a sip.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Phew... This is nice.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: All we did was go to the store and try on a few outfits, but I'm more tired than I thought.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You don't have a lot of stamina, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And... You don't usually wear things like that, after all.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's true I don't have a lot of stamina, but... I didn't dislike trying on those outfits.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I felt like a different person, in a good way. It was a nice new experience.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line:
So, thank you very much...
You've helped me realize something I want to cherish about myself.

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line: I love cute things. And cute clothes...

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line: And this dress. I absolutely adore it...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm glad that I got to see that lady become the person that she always wanted to be.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The person that she always wanted to be...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Just like music, clothes that had a lot of thought and effort put into them have a way of moving people's hearts.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I mean, Yuki poured her heart into the dress that lady said she wanted to wear.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This whole trip was worth it just to see that, I think.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, it's nothing serious...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But thinking about designers putting their feelings into clothes made me wonder about the ones we're wearing right now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm not so sure.
The clothes you're wearing were probably mass-produced.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm inclined to agree. I did choose these sweats because I knew that I could replace them with an exact copy whenever I like.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I'm also inclined to believe that even things like that have thoughts and feelings put into them.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: For example...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, what if they were designed for people who have trouble deciding what to wear each day?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
But they're sweats...
They were probably designed to be quickly replaced in case you rip them or something while doing strenuous exercises.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, you may be right.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I guess I'm not really living up to what the designer or manufacturer wanted from these, huh.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You could always exercise more.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll do enough not to get badly out of shape, at least...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Actually, I might take a look at the website for the company that makes these sweats.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Why?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This conversation is making me wonder what kinds of thoughts and feelings went into them.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That seems unnecessary.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Do you ever wonder what people think about as they listen to N25's songs?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh...? I do make an effort to read through the comments...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But each person is free to think whatever they like. I just hope that they feel a little better after listening to them.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Once something you made leaves your hands, what happens afterwards is entirely up to the listener.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: In that case, I guess I'll stick with these sweats after all.
